block_size.description: Block size (bytes) used for read/write operations.

buffer_size.description: Buffer size (bytes) before writing; must be >= block_size; if null, defaults to block_size.

data_limit.description: Data limit with optional suffix: k=1024, m=1024², g=1024³.

disable_sighup_doubletap.description: If true, disable the SIGHUP double-tap safety (cstream kills itself on single SIGHUP after 5s wait).

input_file.description: Input file path; empty string = stdin; 'hostname:port' = TCP connect; ':port' = TCP listen.

input_type_flags.description: Input file type flags: 'f'=FIFO, 'F'=fsync, 'a'=audio device, 't'=fd3 copy, 'N'=no TCP.

output_file.description: Output file path; '-' = discard; 'hostname:port' = TCP connect; ':port' = TCP listen.

output_type_flags.description: Output file type flags: 'f'=FIFO, 'F'=fsync, 'a'=audio device, 't'=fd3 copy, 'N'=no TCP, 'D'=O_DIRECT, 'S'=O_SYNC.

pid_file.description: Path to write process ID (parent PID if concurrent mode > 0).

throughput_limit.description: Throughput limit in bytes/second; positive for long-term average, negative for per-call upper bound.
